extractedItems.title: Where is your ball classed as 'in the bunker'?
extractedItems.question: Your ball lands right on the border of the sand and some grass inside the bunker. When is it officially classed as 'in the bunker'?

choices.text: Only if it is completely in the sand
If any part touches the sand within the bunker
If it lands on grass in the bunker
When it stops moving anywhere inside the bunker

extractedItems.explanation: The ball is classed as being in the bunker if it touches the sand within it, not grass.

extractedItems.title: What can you do if your ball sinks into the bunker?
extractedItems.question: You hit a shot, and your ball sinks deep into the sand so you can't see it. What are you allowed to do?

choices.text: Leave it and play a different ball
Use your club or feet to search for it, and if it moves, replace it and recreate the lie
Just dig it out and play it as it lies
Ask a friend to search for you, but don't move any sand

extractedItems.explanation: You may use your club or feet to find the ball, and if it moves, you should put it back and recreate the original lie, with no penalty.

extractedItems.imageAlt: A boy golfer in a bunker probing the sand with a club to locate his hidden ball.

extractedItems.title: How can you identify your ball in a bunker?
extractedItems.question: You find a ball in the bunker but aren't sure if it's yours. What should you do to check if it's your ball?

choices.text: Pick it up straight away, no need to mark it
Mark its position, pick it up to check, and try to recreate the original lie
Clean it fully before checking
Ignore it and keep searching for your ball

extractedItems.explanation: To identify your ball, you should mark its spot, then pick it up and check, and recreate the original lie as accurately as possible.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer marking the spot before picking up a golf ball in a bunker to check if it is hers.

extractedItems.ruleName: Do not touch or test the sand
extractedItems.title: Testing or touching the sand in a bunker
extractedItems.question: Before playing your shot from a bunker, which of these actions are NOT allowed?

choices.text: Touching the sand with your hand to test it
Making a practice swing that touches the sand
Grounding your club behind the ball before you hit
Taking your shot without touching the sand first
Leaning on your club outside the bunker

extractedItems.explanation: Testing the sand by touching it or making practice swings that touch the sand, and grounding your club before playing, are all not allowed.
